scope: Controller unit tests using minimal fake DOM/media; not actual rendering, audio synchronization or browser playback QA
mode: actual timing metadata; mocked media events, no decoded-video or browser QA

tests.name: Default activity pause holds each attempt before its answer (4/9/21/28)
Delayed timeupdate beyond a boundary rewinds and pins the previous task
Continue advances to the next slide and resumes playback
Intentional chapter and native seeks do not trigger skipped activities
Replaying a completed activity resets its future pause guard
Turning activity pauses off permits manual playback and clears a shown pause
Timer and animation-frame guards protect boundaries without timeupdate
The break pauses on slide 18 and Continue resumes slide 19
Final slide 31 pauses, Finish stops and the ended fallback does not reopen it
Final ended event also holds unfinished feedback before completion
Wide captions remain native; narrow captions use active timed cues below the image
Caption toggle disables both presentations and restores the appropriate narrow mode
Native full screen uses native captions; narrow wrapper full screen retains separate captions
Late caption loading attaches cue updates and desktop native CC changes update the toggle
